# NamedScan

> NamedScan is an AI visibility service for local businesses. It asks ChatGPT, with live web search, the questions local customers ask, shows whether a business is recommended, mentioned or missing and which businesses are named instead, and delivers a dated, branded PDF report with a prioritized fix list (listings, reviews, website content and structured data). On monthly plans NamedScan works on the signals ChatGPT can use. NamedScan does not promise or guarantee rankings or recommendations.

Pricing shown on the site: a free preview (three customer questions, no card needed), a one time AI visibility report for $5 (15 questions and a PDF), and monthly plans: Starter (Guided) at $199 a month (you make the changes from a prioritized list), Done For You at $300 a month (recommended; NamedScan makes the fixes) and Growth at $500 a month (up to 3 locations, rescans every 2 weeks, competitor tracking and a monthly strategy call). Monthly plans can be cancelled anytime. Checkout is handled by Stripe.

Operated by Joshua Israel Ventures LLC. Contact: joshuaofisrael@gmail.com
